additional_info.body:
Charger will not stop the charging session after ended by the
customer via the screen. Customer needs to end the charging
session via the car and reject plug. Pressing "end charging" via the
screen will not end the session.
170001231 14-10 07.05 uur (utc)
170002181 13-10 17.57 uur (utc)

additional_info.subject: RE: 0384967 - ID0384967-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / R6 170002181] Session not terminating charging from charger screen CRM:02023000210
additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
Hope you are doing well.
We have analyzed the charging logs for both charger IDs you provided with timestamps.
1.For charger ID MP / PD 170001231, the charging session started at 2024-10-14, 06:42:12 UTC and successfully completed at 2024-10-14, 07:06:10         UTC with "transactionId": 33978971. This session proceeded without any issues.
2.Regarding charger ID MP / R6 170002181, there were some problems during the charging session, which began in offline mode with idTag at 2024-       10-13T17:37:56 UTC and ended at 2024-10-13, 17:55:08 UTC. However, the session did not stop with idTag. As the charger was offline and charging       in free mode, we are escalating this matter to our expert team for further investigation.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
